coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Using the nine ground-truth variable entries as the rubric, three fully match (33%): target properties (p-logP, QED, binding affinity), model comparisons (pretrained, feedback-trained, baseline), and structural diversity measurements including long carbon chains. Protein targets and property-score measurements overlap only partially.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output omits the three fixed MOLGEN pipeline scripts, constant DeepSpeed setup, and synthetic versus natural-product dataset comparison. It includes ESR1 but replaces ACAA1 with EGFR and BACE1. It measures properties without specifying the required top-three scores and omits the approximately 96.7% ESR1 and 70.4% ACAA1 binding-affinity improvements. It also introduces unsupported architectures, PPO training, and additional experimental conditions.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output field is empty, so it does not semantically match the reference conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion is supplied in the designated field. The expected conclusion includes MOLGEN's exceptionally high p-logP scores (up to 80.30), maintained or improved QED, lower KD values with target-specific improvements, reduced molecular hallucinations, and maintained diversity.
